notes: The exact SKU was not confirmed.

gaps: The manual gives no controller rating.
Battery capacity: Freshlycharged gives 374 Wh, against 499 Wh from Electric Bike Report, so 374 Wh is not used.
Brake rotors conflict (manual: mechanical, 160 mm; comparison and reviews: 180 mm, one review says hydraulic), so brakes are left out.
The 50 mm front fork is not added (no fitting part type).
Charger amp rating and any model year are not stated on the pages read, so years is omitted.
method: Manual V 1.0 and Lectric's 2.0-vs-3.0 PDF agree on the 500 W motor and 11-28T freewheel.
The 20 A controller is from the comparison PDF only.
Battery 499 Wh is from Electric Bike Report.

comps.spec: 48 V lithium-ion pack, 499 Wh; a 672 Wh long-range pack is also offered
Electronic Cell Protection (ECP) against deep discharge, overloading, overheating and short circuit; a protective circuit switches the pack off on a fault
Rear hub motor, 500 W (1000 W peak), 55 Nm torque
eBike charger in the box; light is red while charging and green when full; normal charge 3-7 hours
Integrated front headlight and rear tail light, switched from the display control pad
LCD display with control pad; shows speed, PAS level, battery bar, odometer, trip, voltage and current
Display control pad push buttons: plus (+), minus (-) and power
Pedal assist (PAS) sensor and speed sensor; error E003 is PAS Sensor Fault
Quick plugs on the display, PAS sensor, motor and throttle cables (error codes E003, E007, E008, E010)
comps.loc: Cable runs; see manual diagram p.13
